notes:
Selected one concrete device from the multi-package clone: labmcp_julabo.driver:JulaboCirculator at servers/chemistry/julabo-circulator/src/labmcp_julabo/driver.py:137 (one of the card entry symbols). The clone was only read; it was not imported, installed or run, and the gate reports it unmodified.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's helper is PythonObjectDriver; this package uses a decorated direct Driver over the same upstream object. The declarative family's safety_bindings do not inspect the native stop() return value, so they cannot turn a stop that never confirms in_mode_05 into a failed e-stop and safe-state receipt; the direct driver does, and it also needs the set-point read-back. The upstream object is synchronous.

Evidence: contract_checked on the fake backend only. The fake is a fixed-state in-memory stand-in (F0, no timing or thermal model), not a recording and not the upstream wire simulator; it does not show that a real stop, temperature change or hardware run occurred. The upstream simulator was not imported or run, and no hardware was attached. The loader refuses the hardware backend of this unreviewed model-authored R2 package until a human sets reviewed_by; reviewed_by stays null and no human reviewed or tested this package.

NOT COVERED: external Pt100 temperature (in_pv_02) and warning limits (in_sp_03/in_sp_04) are model-specific and omitted so every supported model returns the required fields; the auxiliary start_keepalive background thread, the wait-for-temperature loop and the MCP server's tool layer are not re-exported. The primary control (temperature, set point, start, stop) and the native stop are covered.

Limits: the set point is the only numeric write and is Limit.operator_required. site-limits.example.json is an example overlay (5 to 90 Cel mirrors the upstream server's operator-configurable water-bath defaults) and is not a device bound; no text of the clone states the working temperature range.

Safety: no independent hardware e-stop is documented in the clone, so estop_physical_ref is not set; the input-free x-cap.k-dense-ai.stop_circulation.v1 action satisfies SAFE-045 for this R2 driver. It stops temperature control and the pump; the bath stays hot or cold and is not physically isolated. The native stop makes two attempts and the driver raises DriverFailed if in_mode_05 is never confirmed; a package test uses the fake's stop_confirmed=False hook to show the e-stop stays latched with MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED and safe_state_achieved false. The start action starts to the stored set point; the runtime enforces the operator envelope on the set-point write, but the effective site overlay is not exposed to the driver, so it cannot repeat the upstream MCP server's front-panel set-point check (server.py:227-237). A hardware deployment must set the target through this driver or verify a front-panel set point is inside the operator envelope before starting. The stop's worst case (two attempts, 3 s transport timeout, 0.25 s delay) can exceed the runtime's default 1 s e-stop budget on a slow link; the receipt then fails with the latch held, which is the honest result.

The hardware factory is native.py and was never run; it imports labmcp and labmcp-julabo only when the hardware backend is constructed, which needs those distributions installed from the clone (see driver.lock.json install.notes). check-report.json is regenerated by each gate run; the digest above is the last gate run.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review confirmed the JULABO entry, native.py, cited bounds and native stop, but the start action bypasses the upstream server's live set-point guard at server.py:227-237. test_driver.py now reproduces a placeholder 150 Cel stored target starting under the example 5..90 Cel overlay; the regression fails, so G9 and the strict collector fail, with RESULT_UNTRUSTED expected until the orchestrator applies the block. Narrowed three Facts in driver.py and facts.md and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. A guarded start/re-enable contract is required before this R2 package can be accepted. For the human reviewer: Orchestrator must choose a start contract that validates the actual stored target against the effective site envelope before heating; operator preflight is not endpoint enforcement. Preserve the failing regression and the stock gate assertion. The native stop holds the transport lock and can wait behind ordinary I/O; the bath retains thermal energy. MTSICSBalance, IKAStirrer, AlicatDevice and RigolScope are outside this package.
